info.title: AutoFlow Microservices API
info.description: Central OpenAPI 3.0 catalog for implemented AutoFlow HTTP APIs. Swagger UI is served locally at http://localhost:8096. Paths are routed through Traefik at localhost:8088 unless an operation declares a direct service server. Analytics and Integration endpoint contracts, request/response schemas, authentication and error responses are documented here and in each service's docs/API.md.

servers.description: Local API Gateway; services not routed by the gateway must use their direct localhost port.

tags.name: Configuration Service
tags.description: Tenant-scoped runtime configuration, immutable versions and feature flags.

tags.description: Health-only scaffold; no business REST endpoints are implemented.

BearerAuth.description: Paste the raw Keycloak access token; Swagger adds the Bearer prefix.

MoneyDecimal.description: Money as a decimal string with exactly two fractional digits.

orderId.description: The order ID. Amount and currency are resolved from the immutable order quote snapshot.

Problem.description: RFC 7807-style problem response when emitted by the service.

CustomerWriteRequest.description: DTO fields depend on customer/address/consent operation. Individual customer requires firstName and lastName; company requires legalName.

value.description: Any valid JSON scalar, object or array.

subject_id.description: Keycloak subject ID of the recipient

payload.description: JSON object; maximum serialized size 16 KiB.

targetUrl.description: HTTPS URL with an exact hostname entry in INTEGRATION_OUTBOUND_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

payload.description: JSON object; maximum serialized size 16 KiB.

retention_until.description: Future ISO-8601 timestamp, or null for indefinite retention
